site/source/locales/ui-en.yaml, site/source/locales/ui-fr.yaml, site/source/.../RésultatSimple.tsx, site/source/pages/integration/components/CasParticuliers.tsx: changed by the same commit but outside modele-social/règles and not supplied; they cannot alter what the engine computes.

R2.label: HARMLESS_REFACTOR
outside_bounded_set: The decree article fixing the different "taux global" for ACRE periods under L613-7 I (the source of the 50 % first-year rate, the 12,10 % CIPAV constant and the pre-04/2020 grids 25/75/90 and 25/50/90 %) is not in the bounded set; the rule cites Urssaf FAQ and service-public.fr F32318. Values therefore cannot be confirmed or refuted here (abstain).
L131-6-4 (ACRE eligibility, referenced by D131-6-1 and by `dirigeant . exonérations . ACRE`) is not in the bounded set.

The parent commit of 1932d654 (file blob a061b547e, re-indented to 2 spaces) is a pin later than G1 (blob 8914c3ae); the intermediate commits 2024-07-16 -> 2024-09-02 are not supplied, so before/after was measured as G1 vs G1-minus-this-line.

R3.label: MISMATCH
outside_bounded_set: L. 756-5 (legal basis of the DROM micro-social reduction; D756-5 only gives the fractions) and L. 751-1 (list of the collectivités covered) - not in the set.
L. 611-1 2° (which categories get 1/6 rather than 1/3 in the first period; decides whether a BNC profession libérale non réglementée is at 3,9 % or 7,7 % in period a) - not in the set.

The renumbering/transfer instruments that moved L. 133-6-8 to L. 613-7 and the micro-social rate table from D. 131-6-1 to D. 613-4 (D756-5 still cites the old numbers; in S5, D131-6-1 LEGIARTI000036475110 is the ACRE article) - not in the set; the derivation assumes the D613-4 rates are the base.

D613-4 versions LEGIARTI000049624097 (2025-01-01) and LEGIARTI000049624125 (2026-01-01): ids and dates only, no text in S5 - abstain on the DROM rates expected from 2025 (the base rules already encode 24,6 / 26,1 % for BNC, while the DROM constants stay flat at 3,6 %).

D613-4 versions before 2024-07-01 (LEGIARTI000046714712 etc.): no text in S5, so the statement that the rule constants derive from 21,1 / 21,2 % rests on the engine values at 01/06/2024, not on quoted law.
The Urssaf DROM guide (PDF) and FAQ the rule cites as références - external sources, not in the corpus.

outside_bounded_set: The territorial applicability of CSS book I (L136-1 et seq., hence L136-3 and D136-5) and of L131-6 to travailleurs indépendants established at Mayotte: ordonnance n° 96-1122 du 20 décembre 1996 relative à l’amélioration de la santé publique à Mayotte and its application decrees (the Mayotte TI cotisations regime), as amended for the 2025 assiette reform if at all (loi n° 2023-1250 du 26 décembre 2023 art. 18 is only visible here through the nota of L131-6).

Article L241-3 CSS (the national plafond annuel the floor and cap of D136-5 refer to) and the text fixing the separate Mayotte plafond de la sécurité sociale (2 821 €/mois in 2025, 3 022 €/mois in 2026 in the tree): needed to know which PSS the floor/cap should use at Mayotte if they apply.
Article L633-1 CSS (last sentence, the upper bound of the floor named in L136-3 III).

The maintainers’ factual source for “pas de plancher ni de plafond à Mayotte”: not cited in the commit; the tree’s Mayotte notification cites Urssaf “Taux de cotisations - Travailleur indépendant à Mayotte” (taux-cotisations-ti-mayotte.html) and a CSSM leaflet, neither available here.
The added regression test site/test/modele-ti/assiettes.test.ts (+26 lines) is listed in stat.txt but not included in diff.patch.

R1.label: HARMLESS_REFACTOR
outside_bounded_set: The touched rule 'établissement . taux ATMP' (employer accidents du travail / maladies professionnelles rate) is governed by CSS provisions on AT/MP tarification that are not in the bounded set and not available here (no text quoted, none relied upon). None of the 12 bounded S3 articles mentions 'accident', 'AT/MP' or 'maladies professionnelles' (grep count 0). Classifying a URL-only metadata edit does not require them.

R2.label: HARMLESS_REFACTOR
outside_bounded_set: The decree article fixing the reduced global rate of ACRE-eligible micro-entrepreneurs (L613-7 I: 'Un taux global différent peut être fixé par décret ...'); D131-6-1 as given sets only the 12-month duration and the exemption formula of the non-micro regime. The library's 50 % (and the older 25/50/90 % and 25/75/90 % grids) cite URSSAF FAQ and service-public.fr pages, also outside the set. No value from these sources is asserted here.

L131-6-4 (conditions and beneficiaries of the ACRE), referenced by D131-6-1 I/II, is not in the bounded set; the library's applicability rule `dirigeant . exonérations . ACRE` is therefore not checked against text.
The semantics of `privé: oui` are engine documentation (publicodes), not law; they were established by running the engine (list 1220 -> 1227 names; evaluate error before / value after).

R3.label: MISMATCH
outside_bounded_set: L611-1 CSS (which travailleurs indépendants are '2°' -> 1/6, and 'autres cas' -> 1/3 in D756-5 a); the library's and URSSAF's reading '1/3 = CIPAV / libéral réglementé' is adopted but cannot be verified here)
Recodification decree (2020) renumbering D131-6-1 -> D613-4 and L133-6-8 -> L613-7: D756-5 still cites the old numbers; the current D131-6-1 (ACRE) contains no rate table
L751-1 CSS (list of the collectivités = DROM; library key `établissement . commune . département . outre-mer`)
CGI articles 50-0 and 102 ter (micro thresholds for the D756-5 II cap)
URSSAF guide 'Taux auto-entrepreneur dans les Drom' (PDF) and autoentrepreneur.urssaf.fr page cited by the rule `dirigeant . auto-entrepreneur . DROM`

Text of D613-4 versions LEGIARTI000046714712 (2022-12-10..2024-06-01) and LEGIARTI000049623867 (2024-06-01..2024-07-01): not in S5 (ids/dates only); the 21,1 / 21,2 % quotes come from the store's S0/S1 snapshots
D613-4 versions LEGIARTI000049624097 (2025-01-01) and LEGIARTI000049624125 (2026-01-01): announced by id only, no text -> no DROM values derivable for those dates (abstain)
